rationale: C04 flags that 0.0% of 16 extracted equity rows have shares. The raw SOI uses a Par/Shares column for the equity and preferred shares section, and current-period equity rows such as InnovateMR, Industrial Services Group, PracticeTek, and A1 Garage Door Service have populated Par/Shares values. The source therefore supports shares for these equity holdings; the extracted data omitted or failed to map that column.
